artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the illuminated screens is illegible and blurry. While this mimics low-resolution photography, AI generators often struggle to render coherent UI text, resulting in 'lorem ipsum'-like blobs rather than sharp pixels. It is subtle but noticeable upon close inspection.

The reflections are slightly too uniform and smooth compared to the objects themselves. The reflection of the green iPod's screen lacks the specific color variation seen in the actual screen, appearing as a generic green blur.

The inner circle of the click wheel on the bottom-right device appears slightly elliptical or distorted relative to the outer ring, suggesting a minor perspective or geometric inconsistency in the generation.
